replication.target_description: Direct replication of original Study 2 visual analytic prime, belief in God 0–100; Table 2 All Replication Sites row, random-effects synthesis across four sites. The supplied study_r 2 identifies the original paradigm; this article has one replication experiment with four samples.

notes:
Original narrative reports d = 0.60, whereas its Table 2 reports d = 0.59 for the same Study 2 comparison; narrative value retained as printed at the supplied p. 4 locator. Original n quote joins the two condition labels and printed counts with a semicolon. Replication Table 2 has four individual-site effects and a pooled effect; absent a narrower sample locator, the All Replication Sites row is retained. No p for that pooled random-effects effect is printed in Table 2 or the article narrative; p = .38 belongs to the omnibus ANOVA (eta-squared = 0.001), and p = 0.13 belongs to heterogeneity, so neither is paired with pooled d. The replication table sample sizes are post-exclusion counts, confirmed by Methods. No effect-size conversion performed.
Completion source review (n_o): Table 2 gives the two mutually exclusive final Study 2 conditions for the belief-in-God comparison. Participants are the analytic unit; the separate reasoning pilot is excluded. Exclusions are not documented in the supplied main report.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Primary narrative at supplied p. 4 locator prints Cohen’s d = 0.60 for the identified Study 2 comparison. Table 2 prints d = 0.59 for this same test; discrepancy retained explicitly for parent review. Metric identity is explicit in narrative and Table 2 caption.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Exact P = 0.03 belongs to the same Study 2 t(55) = 2.24 comparison as the retained narrative Cohen’s d = 0.60; Table 2 also reports P = 0.03.
